name: Waves: sound and light
description: Oscillations, travelling waves, sound, light, interference and diffraction, taught at the Kepler outpost.
about:
Waves realm ("Waves: sound and light"): oscillations, travelling waves, superposition, sound, light, interference and
diffraction, for an adult who has finished Foundations, Calculus 1 and Mechanics and nothing more. Same Kepler outpost, now
listening and looking: the Signal Ridge. Mira is still the mentor. The concept plan is docs/plans/WAVES-PLAN.md.

chapters.name: Oscillations
chapters.blurb: Springs and pendulums that swing back and forth, losing energy or being driven.

sector.name: Quake Station
sector.purpose: read every tremor the ground sends us

chapters.name: Travelling waves
chapters.blurb: Wavelength, frequency, the wave function and the speed of a wave on a cable.

sector.name: Mast Cables
sector.purpose: send pulses up the mast without snapping a line

chapters.name: Superposition and sound
chapters.blurb: Waves that add, standing waves, the speed and loudness of sound, and pipes.

sector.name: Assembly Hall
sector.purpose: make every voice in the hall clear

chapters.name: Sound on the move
chapters.blurb: Beats, the Doppler effect, shock waves and speakers that cancel.

sector.name: Rover Track
sector.purpose: hear a rover coming and know its speed

chapters.name: Rays of light
chapters.blurb: How light bends, reflects, gets trapped and is focused by mirrors and lenses.

sector.name: Lens Workshop
sector.purpose: grind lenses that put an image exactly where we want it

chapters.name: Interference of light
chapters.blurb: Double slits, thin films, the interferometer and the first single-slit pattern.

sector.name: Fringe Lab
sector.purpose: measure lengths smaller than a wavelength

chapters.name: Diffraction
chapters.blurb: Diffraction patterns, gratings, the limit of a telescope and X-rays in crystals.

sector.name: Crystal Observatory
sector.purpose: split starlight and see inside crystals

mentor.name: Mira
mentor.opening: I’m Mira. Everything on the Signal Ridge is a wobble that travels, and we have to {purpose}. Your task is “{title}.” {brief} The idea we need: {topic}.
mentor.closing: You already have everything this needs from Foundations, Calculus 1 and Mechanics. I’ll work the first example with you, and the guided steps are there whenever you want them.

copy.firstVisit: A wave is just a wobble that travels, and the outpost is full of them: tremors in the rock, notes in the hall, light in the telescope. Learn one wobble well and the rest follow. We begin on a spring in the Quake Station.
copy.allDone: Sound and light now answer to you. Light is an electromagnetic wave: see where it comes from in Electricity and magnetism.
copy.chaptersNote: Seven chapters. Learn every concept in a chapter to unlock a landmark for the outpost. Practice missions are optional.

skills.title: The skill tree
skills.text: Follow the prerequisite branches from oscillations to diffraction. Each mission you finish opens the ideas that are built on it.

visual.title: The concept bench
visual.text: Pick any mission, change its numbers and predict the result before you check it. Nothing here affects your progress, and it all works offline.

help.title: Find the wobble, then follow it.
help.intro: Waves starts where Mechanics ends: with springs, pendulums and energy. It teaches how a wobble travels, and how waves add up, bounce, bend and spread. Every new word and symbol is explained before you are asked to use it, with a worked example first.
help.answers: Answers are numbers: a period in seconds, a frequency in hertz, a speed, a wavelength, a count, or a yes or no typed as 1 or 0; angles are always in radians, and every prompt names the unit of its box.
